speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: You are treating my request to cut the tooling subscription as a sign that I do not care about the morning order window. I am only asking you to acknowledge that we are trading a paid service for a human process, not that we are abandoning the need for reliable alerts.
output.correction: I am not telling you to remove the alerts entirely, I am telling you that the cost of the dedicated tool is not worth the value it adds right now. If you file this as a lack of concern for reliability, you are misreading my position on where our budget should go.
